description: List orders in the workspace. Filter by payment, fulfillment or delivery status, state (open/closed/canceled), customer, company (B2B), pipeline stage, warehouse queue (to pack, in transit, shipping problem, returns), a search string (customer email or company name), currency, or a date range; paginated with skip and limit. Each order carries customerId, companyId and companyName when it was placed for a customer or a company.

companyId.description: Only orders placed for this company record (B2B). Pass the company record's id - find it with list_records on the company model named by the account model's auth.companyField; a company name goes into search instead.

currency.description: Only orders placed in this currency (ISO 4217, e.g. EUR) - order totals are never added across currencies, so filter by it before summing

limit.description: Page size, at most 100; page on with skip while hasMore is true

queue.description: A warehouse work queue, the same tabs as the admin order list: to_pack = open, paid and not yet fully shipped; in_transit = a parcel has a label or is on its way, without a delivery problem; shipping_problem = delivery status exception; returns = an open return. Combines with every other filter.

search.description: Case-insensitive contains match on the customer email or the frozen company name

skip.description: How many orders to skip - the paging offset (there is no offset parameter)

name: list_orders
title: List orders
